inspection.scope: Linear, unextended two-SM-copy twin realization: full complex H=(H_A,H_B), with radial mode retained; PDF pp.1-2 before Eq. (4)'s optional extended-top construction.

claims.locator: PDF p.1 Eq. (1), full right column; p.2 text distinguishing linear UV model from nonlinear Eq. (6)
claims.fact: H is one unconstrained complex SU(4)-fundamental scalar in the linear model. Under the gauged subgroup it decomposes as one ordinary and one twin doublet. Retain the radial mode; do not count separate dependent Goldstone coordinates.

claims.locator: PDF p.2 left column, paragraphs beginning 'This approach' and 'In both'; PDF p.3 Eq. (7)
claims.fact: Gauge two copies of the SM A and B and interchange every SM_A particle with its corresponding SM_B particle in the twin-symmetry branch. Both full chiral family spectra are inherited, with three ordinary families in each declared SM copy; H_A and H_B have hypercharge +1/2 in their own copy and zero under the other.

claims.locator: PDF p.3 Eq. (7) and Atlas normalization convention
claims.fact: Independently normalize each source hypercharge generator to q_A=6Y_A,q_B=6Y_B over the complete inventory. Non-Abelian irreps are exact Bourbaki A2/A1 labels. All Weyl rows use the LH convention; no extra top partners from Eq. (4).
